methodology.scope: 100 leaders from high-population countries with numeric salary estimates
methodology.scope_note: Salary values are approximate monthly USD equivalents calculated from annual official salary estimates; benefits, residence, security, travel and non-salary allowances are usually excluded. Rows without numeric salary are omitted from the main corridor.
methodology.sort_direction: Highest monthly salary gets rank #1; corridor playback reverses entries from lower to higher. Ties keep the previous project order when possible to avoid unnecessary visual churn.
methodology.fact_check_update_2026_06_09: Rechecked all 100 entries against Wikidata/CIA-style current-office signals and production role semantics. Australia, Canada, and Papua New Guinea now show the Governor-General/representative because their salary_basis is governor_general_equivalent_estimate; keeping Charles III there produced a wrong person/salary-photo linkage.
